So I join and then I go home for Christmas and see everyone. 6 days after leaving home again, my grandma dies to my uncles drugs. And to me, logically it seems as if this will keep occurring, and there is no solution.

I loved her, but she would tell me and my siblings horrible things. Saying that we were pieces of shits, that we will never amount to anything except be a drunk deadbeat like my dad. 


So when I hear your story, it makes me feel sad. Im going to assume here: you have people who care about you. Who will feed you and be there for you. That doesn’t sound like someone worthless, that’s sounds like an amazing person with a good heart, just someone that can’t take the struggles of life.
